description:
The BULLS Desert Falcon EVO is a high-performance electric road bike designed for riders who crave speed and precision. Built for long distances and steep climbs, this eBike delivers a sleek and powerful platform perfect for endurance and road riding.

Motor and Battery

Motor: Powered by the Bosch Gen4 Performance Speed motor with 85Nm of torque, the Desert Falcon EVO delivers fast acceleration and responsive performance, ideal for both commuting and extended road rides.

Battery: The integrated Bosch PowerTube 500Wh battery provides long-lasting power while maintaining a clean, aerodynamic look. Charging time is approximately 4.5 hours.

Suspension and Frame

Fork: Equipped with a BULLS Carbon 1.5" tapered steertube fork, ensuring precise handling and shock absorption for a smooth ride.

Frame: Constructed from Aluminum 6061 with internal cable routing for durability and weight savings. Available in 50 / 55 / 60 cm frame sizes to suit different rider heights.

Drivetrain and Brakes

Gears: The Shimano GRX Di2 11-speed drivetrain offers smooth electronic shifting and a broad gear range for varied terrain.

Brakes: Equipped with Shimano GRX RX810 hydraulic disc brakes featuring 180mm rotors front and rear, delivering powerful and consistent stopping performance.

Wheels and Tires

Wheels: Outfitted with DT Swiss HE1800 Spline wheels, balancing agility and stability for fast-paced road riding.

Tires: Fitted with Schwalbe E-One EVO V-Guard 700x32 tires for superior grip, durability, and road feel on a variety of surfaces.

Additional Features

Display: Includes the Bosch Kiox display, providing key ride metrics such as speed, battery level, and distance in a compact and easy-to-read format.

Saddle: Comes with a Selle Royal Asphalt GF saddle for a secure and comfortable ride.

Technology and Design

Class-3 eBike: The Desert Falcon EVO offers pedal assist up to 28 mph, making it ideal for high-speed road use and long-distance travel.

Key Takeaways

The BULLS Desert Falcon EVO combines cutting-edge technology, performance-driven design, and premium components to create an electric road bike that excels in speed, comfort, and precision — perfect for riders ready to push their limits.
